original: WPRPLACE is a national park in south-western Estonia. Soomaa protects 390 km2. The park was created in 1993. Since 1989, Soomaa has been an Important Bird Area, a Ramsar site of protected wetlands since 1997, and a Natura [dated source] area since [dated source].
